PartyLAN bundled Opus runtime

Library: libopus
Version: 1.6.1
Source archive: https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/opus/opus-1.6.1.tar.gz
Source SHA256: 6ffcb593207be92584df15b32466ed64bbec99109f007c82205f0194572411a1
Checksum list: https://downloads.xiph.org/releases/opus/SHA256SUMS.txt

Built locally for Windows x86_64 with CMake and MinGW-w64:

cmake -S tmp/opus/opus-1.6.1 -B tmp/opus/build-win64 -G "MinGW Makefiles" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DOPUS_BUILD_SHARED_LIBRARY=ON -DOPUS_BUILD_TESTING=OFF -DOPUS_BUILD_PROGRAMS=OFF -DOPUS_INSTALL_PKG_CONFIG_MODULE=OFF -DOPUS_INSTALL_CMAKE_CONFIG_MODULE=OFF -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-static-libgcc"
cmake --build tmp/opus/build-win64 --config Release --parallel
